title: Continuity dashboard API and status page
intended_behavior: Expose an authenticated HTTP continuity status read endpoint backed by an injected ContinuityStatusReader rather than fake or placeholder data.
Return continuity status DTOs with service key, active profile, operation state, worker pubkeys, reason, changed timestamp, and current run step details.

Render a /continuity dashboard page that displays per-service status cards with NORMAL, DEGRADED, EMERGENCY, and RECOVERING visual states, primary versus active worker data, run progress, and failure reason text.
Add an operator navigation link to the continuity dashboard.
observed_behavior: internal/service/continuity_status_store.go exposes ContinuityStatusReader and ListAllStatuses for status read-model consumers.

No production app composition wiring for RouterDeps.ContinuityStatuses was present in this checkout; the handler therefore fails closed with HTTP 503 when no store is injected. The follow-up is tracked in Beads issue bahia-mrra.
scope_constraints: Only new API/web files plus router registration and navigation component edits were allowed for existing files.
No domain, service, adapter, controlplane, or DNS files were changed.
